header.description: What: CE-11034 (R-11014, DESIGN_Ambience slice 1) - on basic-desert, no units: ambience LAYERS, entities a renderer plays by KIND (a dotted name, never a sample). An authored layer 'Distant War' (kind battle.distant, intensity 0.6) has no position, so it is heard everywhere, from the start and for ever. A trigger 'Air raid at 30 s' runs the SetAmbience action at 30 s: it asks the creation path for a layer 'Ambience alarm.airraid' (intensity 1, at the town (300, 300), heard within 800 m, 60 s), which ends by itself at its sim time. Judge (100 s): (1) from the start the Distant War sounds; (2) no siren before 30 s; (3) at 30 s the siren appears, at the town, with its radius and an end 60 s after it began; (4) it is still sounding at 80 s; (5) by 95 s it has ended and is gone; (6) the Distant War is still sounding at the end. Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh ambience-air-raid.
